name: FORMAT_PERSIAN_DATE
formula: LAMBDA(day, month, year, TEXT(year, "0000") & "/" & TEXT(MATCH(month, {"فروردین","اردیبهشت","خرداد","تیر","مرداد","شهریور","مهر","آبان","آذر","دی","بهمن","اسفند"}, 0), "00") & "/" & TEXT(day, "00"))

name: GET_CELL_VALUE_BY_PERSIAN_DATE
formula:
LAMBDA(day, month, year, data, colindex, LET(
date,JALALI_TO_GREG(
FORMAT_PERSIAN_DATE(day,month,year)),
 filteredData, FILTER_BY_DATE(data,date),
INDEX(filteredData,,colindex)
))

name: IMPORT_FROM_SHEET
formula: LAMBDA(sheetsfileid, sheetname, datarange, IMPORTRANGE("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/" & sheetsfileid, sheetname & "!" & datarange))

name: GET_ROW_BY_PERSIAN_DATE
formula:
LAMBDA(day, month, year, data, LET(
  persianDate, FORMAT_PERSIAN_DATE(day, month, year),
  header, INDEX(data, 1),
  isCombinedDateFormat, IS_COMBINED_PERSIAN_DATE(INDEX(data,2, 1)),
  
  IF(
    isCombinedDateFormat,
    VSTACK(header, FILTER(data, INDEX(data,,1) = persianDate)),
    VSTACK(header, FILTER(data, FORMAT_PERSIAN_DATE(INDEX(data, ,1), INDEX(data, ,2), INDEX(data, ,3)) = persianDate))
  )
))
